title: Onboard Sentinel: drift & gating brief
overview: Biweekly checkpoint for model onboarding evaluations: synthesizes signal from promptset smoke tests, production-like shadow traffic, and targeted stress prompt groups. This note focuses on small but sharp quality regressions identified across three new promptsets and proposes immediate gating actions plus instrumentation patches to avoid noisy rollouts.
regression_summary: Across the past 14 days we observed a recurring semantic collapse on short-form instruction prompts for two model candidates (model-A-2026-04-28-quant and model-B-2026-05-03-fp16). Aggregate automated eval score (composite accept-rate) dropped ~6.8% on the 'small-business-intent-v2' promptset and ~4.2% on 'email-summarization-smoketest', with the multilingual suite showing increased hallucination rate in DE/PT examples.
numeric_highlights: Semantic-accuracy regression: -5.1% absolute on short-instruction bucket (<= 40 tokens)
KV-cache hit ratio unchanged: 72% (no cache regressions detected)
Latency median increase: +11ms (p50) for model-A quant run under 8k prefix workload
False-positives flagged by eval harness up +18% due to loosened NER anchors
top_failures: Truncation-induced context misalignment: model returns earlier completion that references out-of-scope entity (observed in 34/120 failed examples)
Instruction-following: safe-defer vs comply confusion on 'decline to answer' templates (noted in customer-facing templates)
Multilingual hallucination: German locale tests returned Portuguese place names in DE promptset (multilingual-suite-DE-PT)
Reranking mismatches: top-1 reranker picks lower semantic relevance when prompt contains numeric tables
Template brittleness: few-shot formatting tokens cause template bleed into output (example: '---' marker interpreted as content)

promptset_changes: small-business-intent-v2: remove 28 noisy templates and add 40 higher-variance examples that mimic real customer utterances
email-summarization-smoketest: add polite-defer golden labels and explicit negative examples to reduce false acceptance
multilingual-suite-DE-PT: isolate DE/PT slices and add language-detection precheck to harness
onboard-edge-truncation-1k: new synthetic promptset to stress prefix truncation and KV-cache misalignment
experiment_notes: Preliminary A/B of reranker thresholding reduced incorrect top-1 picks by 12% on numeric-table prompts but increased latency p95 by 40ms — needs batching strategy
Quant kernel change (L2 reorder) likely responsible for p50 increase; reproduces on dev GPU with seqlen=1024 and batch size=8
Shadow traffic mirrors exposed the multilingual bleed that did not appear in synthetic evals — indicates gap in prompt representativeness
